page.overview:
What is Base Town?

Base Town is a location in The Final Fantasy Legend, located at the base of the Tower.

The main characters starts their adventure from this town; they learn that the door in town leads to Paradise, but it is sealed by the black sphere. The main characters then set off on their adventure when they learn from a mysterious man that Gen-Bu has hidden the key to the door in the Statue of Hero.

After the defeat of Gen-Bu, the party returns to the sealed door and use the black sphere which breaks the seal on the door. Once broken, they walk through the door and start climbing the Tower.

After defeating Ashura and falling through a pitfall. They hear a voice calling them from a distance asking them if they can climb out, and when they regain consciousness. They find themselves back in Base Town with the people they have met on their journey.
